csv_project_name: AE for Vicksburg District Bridge & Waterfront
csv_agency: U S Army Corps of Engineers Vicksburg (USACE)
csv_scope_of_work: The work under this contract shall consist of professional services for initial/routine/special/underwater/non-redundant steel tension member (NSTM) inspection, analysis, load rating, and design of highway, railroad and pedestrian bridges for military and civilian loads as well as inspection, analysis, load rating, and design of waterfront facilities/structures such as piers, cargo areas, wharfs, bulkheads, landships, docks, mooring dolphins, etc, for military and civilian loads. Work may be comprised of civil, structural, hydraulic, hydrologic, geotechnical, environmental, electrical, mechanical, surveying, mapping, CADD, and architectural design. Work may include, but is not limited to studies, preparation of sketches, conceptual drawings, related drafting, cost estimates, specifications, contract drawings, and design analysis. Studies, designs, and drawings shall be in English and/or metric units as directed by each task order or the contracting officer.
